# Voice Studio (Kitaab se Awaaz)

> Accessible PDF, EPUB, and Word to MP3 audiobook and Urdu/English text-to-speech web studio built by Moutter Rasool in Faisalabad, Pakistan.

Voice Studio turns textbooks, academic handouts, EPUB books, and bilingual Urdu-English notes into clean MP3 audio (~28 MB per hour for mobile data and WhatsApp), uncompressed WAV, synced .SRT/.VTT captions, and subtitled study videos. All document reading and cleanup happen privately inside the user's browser without server file storage. Built WCAG 2.1 AA screen-reader first.

## Key Capabilities
- Urdu and English bilingual text-to-speech with RTL Urdu support and custom Pronunciation Dictionary
- Automatic removal of repeating PDF page numbers, running headers, and broken line hyphens
- Chapter extraction, Audiobook ZIP packaging, and scanned PDF page reading
- Two-speaker Host and Guest podcast script builder and multi-language translator
- Synchronized .SRT/.VTT subtitles and 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1 subtitled video export
- 3,000 free characters daily for verified accounts plus Bring Your Own Gemini API Key unlimited mode
